name: Nanami Haruka
source:
Nanami is a world famous singer who is popular all over the world.  Even though she's not from a rich family she is allowed to stay on the Princess Mary as a "special guest". Her wish is to achieve world peace through her music. She's pretty much a genki, onee-chan type character but was actually quite fun to have around.

[Edited from [url=http://liemyx.livejournal.com/1263.html]Liemyx's review[/url].]
